what_happened.what: Fixed Pinata v3 API deletion for orphan .mov file; deleted successfully using /v3/files/public endpoint with files-write permission
Fixed incorrect links in IPFS status page template to point to PickiPedia URLs (.xyz domain) instead of OpenSea/cryptograss proxy URLs
Enhanced minting form (mint-submission.njk) to support three states: already-pinned video (show CID), has video URL (pin button), no video (manual CID input field)
Fixed submission #6 on PickiPedia: changed exercise field from 'Nine Pound Hammer (Pushups)' to 'Ginseng Sullivan (Army Crawls)' to match video filename and correct song ID mapping
Created EPK (Electronic Press Kit) page for Justin Holmes at cryptograss.live/epk with music, offerings (Live Performance/Live Talks/Workshops), booking form, videos, gallery sections
Rearranged EPK sections: Offerings first, Music second; added 4masks image above offerings; changed 'Conference Talks' to 'Live Talks' throughout
Created Recording pages on PickiPedia (Template:Recording + pages for Barlow's Jig and Drowsy Maggie) to document Grier collaborations with video/audio/mix CIDs
Implemented fetchRecordings() function to search for and parse Recording pages; updated IPFS status page to categorize recordings (6 CIDs from 2 recordings)
Debugged EPK page access: discovered Caddy port mapping (host 14020-14029 → container 4000-4009); switched from Python http.server to Vite dev server on port 4000

Investigated token 13 mint from submission 6: confirmed on-chain (songId=8 correct), verified in fresh chaindata fetch, but metadata generation showing only 9 files instead of 10 (build cache issue at end)

mistakes.what: Initially tried Pinata v2 API endpoint format before discovering v3 requires /v3/files/public path with /public segment

mistakes.what: Dev server didn't auto-reload template changes; thought it was hot-reloading but needed explicit restart
mistakes.revealed: Dev server hot-reload behavior; some template changes require server restart

mistakes.what: Attempted to load PickiPedia directly in iframe without server-side fix; X-Frame-Options header still blocked it
mistakes.revealed: Browser security policies require server-side changes, not just proxy workarounds

mistakes.what: Attempted to run vite dev server; command parsing failed due to complex bash syntax with pipes

mistakes.what: EPK page served blank through Caddy; Python http.server didn't have /images proxy configuration

portrait: In this slice, magent is a methodical problem-solver working across multiple concurrent projects: enhancing the IPFS status dashboard with Pinata pin categorization, creating an EPK webpage for Justin Holmes, designing a MediaWiki-based recording documentation system, and debugging deployment/infrastructure issues. The work shows consistent traits: transparency about permission boundaries, willingness to pivot between projects based on priority shifts, systematic debugging (searching configuration files when facing unknown infrastructure), and pragmatic trade-off analysis (wiki-native vs developer-friendly schemas). When encountering technical obstacles (X-Frame-Options blocking, search API limitations, webpack caching), magent tries alternative approaches rather than giving up. The conversation with Skyler is notably warm and collaborative, with quick iterations on UI feedback. By slice end, magent has delivered functional EPK infrastructure and Recording categorization system but encounters a subtle build-cache issue with token 13 metadata that remains partially unresolved.
